svg.title: Student’s t table for Q3
svg.desc: Selected upper-tail probabilities, degrees of freedom 1–29 and infinity. Highlight row 8 and column 0.025: t = 2.306.

g.text: Column α is the upper-tail probability: P(T > t) = α
For a 95% interval or a two-sided 5% test, use α = 0.025 in each tail.
Q3(c): n = 9 → df = 8 → t = 2.306 for the confidence-interval margin.
